questions.prompt: Why does it matter that the heart is divided into a right side and a left side?
options: It lets each side beat at a different speed
It keeps oxygen-rich blood from mixing with oxygen-poor blood
It lets blood skip the lungs when the body needs it
It lets the right side carry blood to the whole body

questions.prompt: A drop of blood has just returned from the big toe to the heart. Which chambers and organ does it pass through before it leaves the heart through the aorta?
The ventricles fill with blood while they contract during systole.
A blocked coronary artery could starve part of the heart muscle of oxygen, even while the heart keeps pumping blood to the body.
